bugs.title: A second browser using the same valid code hijacks the first phone's pairing; host confirms, phone never completes
bugs.repro: Start pairing; phone A pairs (safety number shown); phone B enters the same code before the host confirms (it fails with 'Your computer did not answer' but its socket stays open); host confirms phone A.
bugs.evidence: Host says paired; phone A stays on the safety-number screen forever (14-hijack-phone-stuck-after-host-confirm.png, 11-intruder-same-code.png). Relay server.py sets room.device to the latest socket so the confirmation frame goes to B. Reproduced 4 times. A ghost paired device remains on the host.

bugs.title: Confirming a stale pairing (phone already gone) creates a paired device and stores a key
bugs.repro: Pair from a phone, close the phone page, press Check again on host, confirm the entry.
bugs.evidence: Host says paired; Paired devices list grew with ghost entries (6+ identical 'Chaos phone').

bugs.title: Non-dict request (null, [], string, number) from a paired device gets no reply and logs tracebacks on the host
bugs.repro: On a paired phone console: request(null), request([]), request('str'), request(42).
bugs.evidence: Phone: 'No answer. Try again.' after 60 s; server.log has 7 Tracebacks. Host kept working afterwards.

bugs.title: Relay ttl=abc query crashes the handler (close 1011)

undesired.title: Relay address box resets to the deployed Cloudflare address on every reload and the note says Not connected while the relay is actually connected
undesired.detail: After reloading the host page the field shows the workers.dev address although ws://127.0.0.1:8026 was saved; pressing Connect would silently move to a third-party relay.

undesired.title: Paired and waiting device lists are indistinguishable and stale
undesired.detail: Abandoned pairings stay in Waiting for you to confirm (identical names, only a safety number); Paired devices shows no time or id, so removing the right one is guesswork.

undesired.title: Host is not told about wrong-code lockout
undesired.detail: After 5 wrong guesses the correct code is refused with 'The relay refused that.' on the phone; nothing on the host.

undesired.title: Misleading phone errors
undesired.detail: Used code and wrong state both say 'Your computer did not answer. Start pairing there first.'; a voice_start refusal never reaches request() so it waits 60 s.

undesired.title: Relay has no limits
undesired.detail: 300 anonymous year-long rooms created in 0.4 s; no rate limit; no CSP or nosniff headers on the phone page.

undesired.title: Two Check again buttons on Settings
undesired.detail: Model section and remote section use the same label; ambiguous.
